FINAL DECISION - DISMISSAL
Petitioner Lamptey filed an appeal seeking accidental disability retirement benefits. On
November 1, 2024, I sent her an order to show cause why her appeal should not be dismissed due to
her failure to submit a prehearing memorandum by August 30, 2024 as ordered. I gave her until
December 6, 2024 to respond. No response was received.
Accordingly, this appeal is dismissed for failure to prosecute. 801 CMR 1.01(7)(g)3.
DIVISION OF ADMINISTRATIVE LAW APPEALS
